title: 4.7.3. Acquiring and Losing Citizenship: Introduction 🌐
content: 📌 ውድ የኢትዮፍሬሽ ተማሪዎቻችን! እንኳን ወደ ምዕራፍ 4 ትምህርታችን አምስተኛው እና የመጨረሻው ክፍል በሰላም መጣችሁ! 👋✨ ዛሬ የሲቪክስ እና ፖለቲካ ትምህርታችንን እጅግ አስፈላጊ ወደሆነው Modes of Acquiring and Losing Citizenship (ዜግነትን የማግኛ እና የማጣት መንገዶች) ክፍል እንሸጋገራለን። Universal Principles (UDHR 1948): • Article 15: እ.ኤ.አ በ1948 የወጣው አለምአቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብቶች መግለጫ "ማንኛውም ሰው የዜግነት መብት አለው" እንዲሁም "ማንም ሰው ያለአግባብ ዜግነቱን አይቀማም" ሲል ይደነግጋል። • State Discretion: ዜግነት የመስጠት መብት የየሀገራቱ Sovereign (ሉዓላዊ) ስልጣን በመሆኑ የዜግነት ህጎች ከሀገር ሀገር ይለያያሉ። 👉በአጠቃላይ ዜግነትን ለማግኘት ሁለት ዋና ዋና መንገዶች አሉ፦ By Birth (በትውልድ) እና By Naturalization/Law (በህግ/በስደት ወይም በፈቃድ)። እነዚህን በዝርዝር እንመልከታቸው👇

title: 4.7.3.1. Ways of Acquiring Citizenship: By Birth & Law 👶⚖️
content: 📌 i) Citizenship from Birth / Of Origin: • Jus Soli (Law/Right of the Soil): "A principle whereby an individual is permitted to obtain citizenship status of a particular State because he/she was born in the territorial administration of that country." • Jus Sanguinis (Law/Right of Blood): "A norm where citizenship is acquired claiming one's parents citizenship status (father and/or mother)." Diplomatic Immunity Exception: • "Jus Soli could not apply to children born from diplomats and refugees living in a host State due to international diplomatic immunities: extraterritoriality and inviolability principles." ii) Citizenship by Naturalization / Law: • Definition: "The legal process by which foreigners become citizens of another country." • Political Case: "Acquiring citizenship following conquest, cession, merger, subjugation, or secession of a territory." • Other Sub-principles: Grant on application, marriage, legitimatization/adoption, and reintegration/restoration. 👉የፅንሰ-ሃሳብ ማብራሪያና ምሳሌ፦ • Jus Soli: በሀገሩ ግዛት መወለድ ሲሆን፤ Jus Sanguinis: ደግሞ የወላጆችን የደም መስመር መከተል ነው። • የዲፕሎማቶች ምሳሌ (Diplomatic Exception): የዲፕሎማቲክ ኤምባሲ ቅጥር ጊቢ እንደ ልዑኩ ሀገር ግዛት (Extraterritoriality) ይቆጠራል። ለምሳሌ አሜሪካ በ Jus Soli (በግዛቷ መወለድ) ዜግነት ብትሰጥም፣ ዋሽንግተን ዲሲ በሚገኘው የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ ውስጥ የሚሰሩ የኢትዮጵያ ዲፕሎማቶች እዚያው ኤምባሲ ጊቢ ውስጥ ልጅ ቢወልዱ፣ ልጁ የአሜሪካን ዜግነት አያገኝም! ምክንያቱም ኤምባሲው የኢትዮጵያ ግዛት ተደርጎ ስለሚቆጠር ነው። 💡 Exam Focus: Differentiate Jus Soli (Territory/Soil) vs Jus Sanguinis (Parentage/Blood)!

title: 4.7.3.2. Modes of Acquiring Ethiopian Citizenship: By Descent 🇪🇹
content: 📌 Historical & Legal Framework in Ethiopia: • 1930 Ethiopian Nationality Law: First inscribed legal document. Stated: "Any person born in Ethiopia or abroad, whose father or mother is Ethiopian, is an Ethiopian subject." • 1995 FDRE Constitution (Article 6(1)): "Any person of either sex shall be an Ethiopian national where both or either parent is Ethiopian." • Ethiopian Nationality Proclamation No. 378/2003 (Article 3): 1. "Any person shall be an Ethiopian national by descent where both or either of his/her parent is Ethiopian." 2. "An infant who is found abandoned in Ethiopia shall, unless proved to have a foreign nationality, be deemed to have been born to an Ethiopian parent." 👉CRITICAL EXAM POINT: ኢትዮጵያ የ Jus Soli (የመሬት ህግ) መርህን አትከተልም! በኢትዮጵያ ግዛት ውስጥ መወለድ ብቻ የኢትዮጵያ ዜግነትን አያስገኝም። የኢትዮጵያ ዜግነት በትውልድ የሚገኘው በ Jus Sanguinis (በደም መስመር - እናት ወይም አባት ኢትዮጵያዊ ሲሆኑ) ብቻ ነው! • ምሳሌ፦ የውጭ ሀገር ዜጋ የሆኑ ቱሪስቶች አዲስ አበባ ውስጥ ልጅ ቢወልዱ፣ ልጁ በኢትዮጵያ ግዛት ስለተወለደ ብቻ የኢትዮጵያ ዜግነት አያገኝም። 💡 Exam Hint: Does Ethiopia accept Jus Soli? Answer: NO, strictly Jus Sanguinis!

title: Ethiopian Citizenship by Naturalization: Application & Marriage 📝💍
content: 📌 Acquisition by Law (Proclamation No. 378/2003): a) Grant on Application / Registration (Article 5): • 1. Reach the age of majority (18 years). • 2. Lived in Ethiopia for a total of at least 4 years. • 3. Has sufficient and lawful source of income. • 4. Able to communicate in any indigenous language spoken in Ethiopia. • 5. Has good character & no recorded criminal conviction. • 6. Released from previous nationality (or stateless). • 7. Take the Oath of Allegiance (Article 12). b) Cases of Marriage (Article 6): • 1. Marriage contracted per Ethiopian laws or laws of the contracting State. • 2. Marriage lapsed for at least 2 years. • 3. Lived in Ethiopia for at least 1 year preceding application. • 4. Reach age of majority, good character, and take the Oath of Allegiance. 👉በማመልከቻ (Application) ዜግነት ለማግኘት የ 4 ዓመት መኖሪያ ሲያስፈልግ፤ በጋብቻ (Marriage) ደግሞ የ 2 ዓመት የጸና ጋብቻ እና የ 1 ዓመት መኖሪያ ያስፈልጋል!

title: Adoption, Special Cases & Re-Admission in Ethiopia 👶🌟
content: 📌 c) Cases of Adoption / Legitimating (Article 7): • Child adopted by an Ethiopian citizen acquires nationality if: under 18 years old, lives in Ethiopia with adopting parent, and released from previous nationality. If one adopting parent is foreign, written agreement is required. d) Citizenship by Special Cases (Article 8): • An alien who has made an outstanding contribution in the interest of Ethiopia may be conferred nationality without undergoing requirements of 4 years residence and language ability! e) Re-Admission to Ethiopian Nationality / Reintegration (Article 22): • A person who lost Ethiopian citizenship may regain it by applying to the Authority, returning/domiciling in Ethiopia, and renouncing foreign nationality. 👉ልዩ ምሳሌ (Special Case): ለምሳሌ አንድ የውጭ ሀገር ሳይንቲስት ወይም ስፖርተኛ ለኢትዮጵያ ትልቅና ልዩ አስተዋፅዖ ካበረከተ፣ የ 4 ዓመት መኖሪያና የቋንቋ ችሎታ መስፈርቶች ሳይጠየቁበት በልዩ ሁኔታ የኢትዮጵያ ዜግነት ሊሰጠው ይችላል! 💡 Exam Focus: Know which requirements are waived under "Special Cases" (Residence & Language)!

title: Examination Committee & Naturalization Process 🏢📜
content: 📌 Examining and Deciding Procedure (Articles 10, 11, 23): • Application submitted to: Security, Immigration and Refugee Affairs Authority. • Examined by the Nationality Affairs Committee (5 Members): The 5 Committee Members: 1. 👤 Representative of Security, Immigration & Refugee Affairs Authority (Chairperson) 2. 🏛️ Representative of Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Member) 3. ⚖️ Representative of Ministry of Justice (Member) 4. 👮 Representative of Federal Police Commission (Member) 5. 📝 Representative of the Authority (Member & Secretary) Final Approval: • Committee submits recommendation -> Authority approves -> Applicant takes Oath of Allegiance -> Certificate of Naturalization conferred. 😅 Quick Joke: Passing this 5-member committee is harder than passing a final exam, but once you take the Oath of Allegiance, you're officially in! 👉የዜግነት ማመልከቻን መርምሮ ውሳኔ የሚሰጠው ኮሚቴ 5 አባላት አሉት።

title: 4.7.3.3. Dual Citizenship & Indelible Allegiance 🌐⛓️
content: 📌 Dual Citizenship Definition: • "The condition of being a citizen of two nations (or multiple citizenship for more than two). Arises due to clash among Jus Soli, Jus Sanguinis, and Naturalization laws." Ethiopian Legal Position (Article 20(1)): • "Any Ethiopian who voluntarily acquires another nationality shall be deemed to have voluntarily renounced his Ethiopian nationality." (Ethiopia prohibits dual citizenship!). The Exception — Indelible Allegiance (Article 19(4) & 20(4)): • A person who retains another citizenship or renounces Ethiopian nationality MAY NOT be released from Ethiopian citizenship if: 1. Has not discharged outstanding national obligations. 2. Has not been acquitted or served penalty for an accused/convicted crime. 👉ምሳሌ፦ አንድ ኢትዮጵያዊ የአሜሪካን ዜግነት ቢያገኝ በኢትዮጵያ ህግ የኢትዮጵያ ዜግነቱ ይሰረዛል። ነገር ግን ግለሰቡ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ያልተከፈለ የግብር እዳ ወይም ያልጨረሰው የወንጀል እስራት ካለበት፣ ያንን ግዴታ እስኪያጠናቅቅ ድረስ የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት ዜግነቱን አይሰርዝለትም፤ በዚህም ምክንያት በ Indelible Allegiance ጊዜያዊ የሁለት ሀገር ዜግነት ይኖረዋል።

title: 4.7.4. Ways of Losing Citizenship: 4 Main Modes ❌ global
content: 📌 Primary Rationale for Loss: Absence of a genuine link with the state, fraud, or disloyalty (subversion, draft evasion, desertion). Four Commonly Discussed Ways of Losing Citizenship: 1. Deprivation: "Involuntary loss of citizenship when government authorities or court take a decision to nullify citizenship due to treason, fraud, or serving foreign military." 2. Lapse / Expiration: "Loss of citizenship due to long-term continuous residence abroad (e.g., India revokes nationality after 7 continuous years abroad)." 3. Renunciation: "Voluntary way of losing citizenship initiated by the individual (UDHR Article 15)." 4. Substitution: "When original citizenship is substituted by another state through naturalization or territorial annexation/subjugation." 👉Deprivation ባልተፈለገ ሁኔታ በመንግስት/በፍርድ ቤት የሚወረስ ሲሆን፤ Renunciation ደግሞ በግለሰቡ መልካም ፈቃድ የሚደረግ ነው።

title: Losing Ethiopian Citizenship: Constitutional Protections 🇪🇹🛡️
content: 📌 Constitutional Guarantees in Ethiopia: • NO Deprivation (መገፈፍ የተከለከለ ነው): - Article 33(1) of FDRE Constitution & Article 17 of Proclamation 378/2003 state: "No Ethiopian national shall be deprived of his or her Ethiopian nationality against his or her will." - ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ዜግነትን በመንግስት አስገዳጅነት መገፈፍ (Deprivation) በህግ በፍፁም አይቻልም! • NO Lapse / Expiration: Lapse በኢትዮጵያ ህግ ውስጥ አይሰራም። • Modes Applicable to Ethiopia (Articles 19 & 20): 1. Renunciation (በፈቃድ መተው - Article 19): በራስ ፈቃድ የዜግነት መተው ማመልከቻ በማስገባት። 2. Acquisition of Other Nationality (Article 20): የሌላ ሀገር ዜግነት በፈቃድ ሲያገኙ በ Substitution መተው። 👉በኢትዮጵያ ህግ መሰረት አንድ ዜጋ ምንም አይነት ከባድ ወንጀል እንኳን ቢሰራ ከፈቃዱ ውጭ በኃይል ዜግነቱን ሊቀማ/ሊገፈፍ (Deprived) አይችልም! 💡 Exam Hint: Can an Ethiopian be deprived of citizenship as punishment? NO! Article 33 forbids Deprivation!

title: 4.7.4.1. Statelessness & Chapter Summary 🌐🎓
content: 📌 Statelessness (ዜግነት አልባነት): • Definition: "A condition of having no citizenship of any country and with no government from which to ask protection. Under international law, a stateless person is not considered a national by any state." • Causes: State failure, conquest, civil war, famine, oppressive regimes, or renouncing citizenship without gaining a new one. • UN Action: Adoption of conventions for the protection and reduction of stateless persons. Chapter Summary: • State & Government: State is an institution created to ease complex societal interactions; Government is its administrative arm. • Citizenship: Formal legal relation between State and individual, as well as active civic participation for the common good. --- 🎯 ❤️ ውድ የኢትዮፍሬሽ ተማሪዎቻችን! የዛሬው እና የመጨረሻው የምዕራፍ 4 ክፍል 5 ትምህርታችን በታላቅ ስኬት ተጠናቋል። ለምታደርጉት ጥረትና ጥንካሬ ኩራት ይሰማናል፤ ለፈተናችሁ ከፍተኛ ውጤትና ስኬት እንመኛለን! 🙏🙏🙏
